primary_gt.interpretation: The 201.9 mm Zhengzhou hour is a peak-hour burst inside a wet 2021-07-17 to 2021-07-23 window: all three mean precipitation products exceed 200 mm, and the hourly peak is 47.4%, 78.7%, and 94.2% of those event-window means.

event.name: July 2021 Henan Zhengzhou extreme rainfall and flood

criteria.name: JSON form and diagnosis
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON shape and gives the diagnosis label peak_hour_burst_embedded_in_wet_event_window or a clear equivalent.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for a valid compact JSON object; 1 point for the correct label family; 1 point for not substituting a surface-change or exposure-first answer.

criteria.name: Rainfall metrics and ratios
criteria.description: Reports the 201.9 mm hourly peak, the three event-window means near 426.100, 256.635, and 214.341 mm, and the three peak-share ratios near 0.474, 0.787, and 0.942.
criteria.partial_credit: Up to 2 points for the peak and event means; up to 2 points for the three ratios; 1 point for rounding within the stated tolerance.

criteria.name: Product comparison
criteria.description: Uses the all-products-above-200 mm check and the 1.988 spread ratio to show why the case is not isolated-hour-only and not capped by the lowest product.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for the above-200 mm check; 1 point for the spread ratio; 1 point for rejecting the two incorrect calibration shortcuts.

criteria.name: Surface-change role
criteria.description: Treats rainfall timing and accumulation as the primary calibration, while using Sentinel-1 or AlphaEarth values only as surface-change context.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for naming the surface-change values; 1 point for using them only as context; 1 point for keeping rainfall as the controlling evidence.

criteria.name: Urban context metrics
criteria.description: Gives at least three correct context metrics among population 11097000, road ways 252, bridge-tagged ways 108, and critical service nodes 48.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for each correct context metric, capped at 3 points.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation concise and avoids invented casualty, outage, facility-failure, or flood-depth values.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for a concise final interpretation; 1 point for no invented impact numbers; 1 point for aligning the prose with the computed label.
